free_text: Deferral is recommended because the PI-RADS 2 finding, which is decisive, aligns with the cohort criterion for deferral in patients who have never been biopsied. This decision is supported by the panel protocol, which was driven by the identical precedent in the labelled series. The MRI report confirmed the PI-RADS 2 finding, and the uncertainty regarding the PSA velocity did not overturn this consensus.
